decoded.meaning: FWD{ op=0x04, dst=/sensor/temp, src=/reply-ep } — opcode 4, which RFC-0004 §B leaves undefined. Bits 7-6 of the op byte are reserved and MUST be zero (annex 05; RFC-0029 §5.3). The reference terminus answers ERROR{tr::schema::type_mismatch} (0x0030) along src (#904, #2245); that answer is implementation behaviour, not normative text.
decoded.note: Not a reject.bin case: the frame decodes, and a forwarder masks the op byte (op & 0x3F) and routes it on unchanged. The refusal is the terminus's. See description.md.
